text.description: {A:condition} {stakes} hurdle of woven {wattle}, mud at its feet and straw trampled through the run.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a line of {stakes.color} {stakes} stakes with woven {wattle.color} {wattle} panels between them, a muddy line along the open side.

text.description: {A:condition} {gate} gate swinging in a hurdle run, tied to its post with a loop of twine.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: an open {gate.color} {gate} gate frame hung on one stake post, set ajar in a line of hurdles.

text.description: {A:condition} {walls} henhouse with a perch through it and {straw} drifting from the pop hole.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a square {walls.color} {walls} shed, a perch line across the middle, a small pop hole in the front wall, {straw.color} {straw} spilled below it.

text.description: {A:condition} raised {box} hutch with a wire front and hay pulled through the mesh.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a raised {box.color} {box} box on short legs, a wire front along its open face, hay strewn below.

text.description: {A:condition} round {tower} dovecote, entry holes ringing the top and the murmur of pigeons inside.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a round {tower.color} {tower} tower with dark entry holes ringing its upper edge, a narrow opening at its base.

text.description: {A:condition} coiled-straw {skep} on a stool, a few bees crawling over its crown.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a coiled {skep.color} {skep} dome sitting on a low stool, a dark entry gap low on one side, a few bees about it.

text.description: {A:condition} {frame} rack of bars with {hay} pulled through the slots and droppings strewn below.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a {frame.color} {frame} frame of upright bars along its back edge, {hay.color} {hay} bundled behind them.

text.description: {A:condition} conical {rick} rick on staddle stones, its thatched top combed smooth against the rain.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a round conical {rick.color} {rick} rick, darker combed thatch ringing the crown, the tips of staddle stones showing under its edge.

text.description: {A:condition} loose {hay} pile under the rafters, a pitchfork left standing in it.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a rough square of piled {hay.color} {hay}, darker patches pressed down, the shadow of rafters across it, a fork handle standing proud.

text.description: {A:condition} {churn} churn with its plunger handle set crosswise and a splash of milk dried round the rim.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a round {churn.color} {churn} churn with a cross-bar plunger handle over its mouth, a wet ring on the floor about it.

text.description: {A:condition} pair of tall {cans} {noun}, lids on and a drip dried down one side.
text.physical: Top-down view of {noun}: two tall {cans.color} {cans} cans standing side by side, domed lids on top, one carrying handle raised.

text.description: {A:condition} sloped {table} butter worker, scotch hands crossed on it and a pat of butter to one side.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a sloped {table.color} {table} working table with a raised rim, scotch hands crossed at the middle, a pat of butter at the near corner.

text.description: {A:condition} {bin} grain bin raised on staddle stones, its lid ajar and {grain} spilling over the lip.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a long {bin.color} {bin} bin on low stone feet, lid boards ajar at one end, {grain.color} {grain} heaped at the gap.

text.description: {A:condition} heavy {beam} plough with an {share} share, its shafts parked forward and mud dried on the mouldboard.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a heavy {beam.color} {beam} beam with handle staves, a bright {share.color} {share} share blade at one end, shafts reaching forward, clods dried on the blade.

text.description: {A:condition} peg {frame} harrow, its {tines} tines bent from stones and roots.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: an open grid frame of {frame.color} {frame} bars with {tines.color} {tines} tines standing in rows, a draw chain coiled over one corner.

text.description: {A:condition} flat {cart} cart on two wheels, chaff and loose hay still on the boards.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a flat {cart.color} {cart} bed with low side rails, two iron-tyred wheels showing at the sides, shafts forward, chaff scattered on the boards.

text.description: {A:condition} four-wheel {wagon} wagon under {A:canvas} hoop cover, iron-shod and mud to the hubs.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a long {wagon.color} {wagon} wagon bed, {canvas.color} {canvas} hoops arched over it, four iron-shod wheels at the corners, shafts forward.

text.description: {A:condition} steaming muck heap, a fork stuck in it and straw flecked through.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a rough round heap of dung and {heap.color} {heap} straw, darker wet streaks down it, a fork handle standing off centre.
